_meta.version: v4.5 D.G fixtures (shapes B + C + D, D via Option-Z + post-processor)
_meta.d_shape_note: Shape-D entries reuse the shape-B Option-Z ArgmaxWhere formalization (same table, same entity pair, same measure column) and add fields subject_entity / direction_if_subject_{wins,loses}. At evaluation time the post-processor maps the kernel-verified winning entity to the direction word: if witness matches subject_entity, answer = direction_if_subject_wins; else direction_if_subject_loses.

fixtures.question: Which has a larger july 1 , 2013 projection: Egypt or Yemen?
fixtures.lean_goal_type: Σ (e : String), Σ (v : Value), Evidence Grade.Verified (ArgmaxWhere "july 1 , 2013 projection" (Cond.or (Cond.propEq "country (or dependent territory)" (Value.str "egypt")) (Cond.propEq "country (or dependent territory)" (Value.str "yemen"))) e v)

fixtures.question: What is the july 1 , 2013 projection of Egypt?
fixtures.lean_goal_type: Σ (v : Value), Evidence Grade.Verified (HasProperty "egypt" "july 1 , 2013 projection" v)
